WITH active_convs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.id AS conversation_id, c.external_user_id, c.channel_account_id, c.last_message_at, c.metadata
  FROM conversations c
  JOIN conversation_messages m ON m.conversation_id = c.id
  WHERE m.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '365 days'
)
SELECT
  ac.conversation_id,
  coalesce(ac.metadata->>'customer_name', '') AS fb_customer_name,
  ac.external_user_id,
  ac.channel_account_id,
  ac.last_message_at,
  coalesce(ca.channel_type, 'facebook') AS platform,
  coalesce(ca.external_account_id, ca.config->>'page_id', '') AS page_id,
  coalesce(ca.name, ac.metadata->>'page_name', 'Fanpage') AS page_name,
  coalesce((ca.config->>'product_id')::bigint, (ac.metadata->>'product_id')::bigint, 1369) AS product_id,
  coalesce(ca.config->>'product_name', ac.metadata->>'product_name', 'CMS IntelliCAD') AS product_name,
  CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(ca.channel_type, 'facebook')) = 'facebook'
    THEN 'https://business.facebook.com/latest/inbox/all?asset_id=' || coalesce(ca.external_account_id, ca.config->>'page_id', ca.secret_ref, '') || '&selected_item_id=' || ac.external_user_id
    ELSE '' END AS conversation_link,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', m.id,
      'sender', m.sender_type,
      'text', m.content,
      'created_at', m.created_at
    ) ORDER BY m.created_at ASC)
    FROM conversation_messages m
    WHERE m.conversation_id = ac.conversation_id
  ), '[]'::json) AS messages,
  (
    SELECT row_to_json(l) FROM (
      SELECT l.id AS lead_id, l.full_name, l.phone, l.email, l.company,
             l.customer_type, l.requested_quantity, l.need, l.status AS lead_status,
             qr.request_code, qr.status AS quote_status
      FROM leads l
      LEFT JOIN quote_requests qr ON qr.conversation_id = l.conversation_id
      WHERE l.conversation_id = ac.conversation_id
      ORDER BY l.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ) l
  ) AS old_lead
FROM active_convs ac
LEFT JOIN channel_accounts ca ON ca.id = ac.channel_account_id
ORDER BY ac.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
),
lead_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO leads (
    conversation_id, product_id, full_name, phone, email, company,
    customer_type, requested_quantity, need, source, status, last_contacted_at, idempotency_key, updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    (data->>'conversation_id')::uuid,
    coalesce((data->>'product_id')::bigint, 1369),
    coalesce(nullif(trim(data->>'customer_name'), ''), nullif(trim(data->>'fb_customer_name'), ''), 'Khách Facebook'),
    coalesce(nullif(trim(data->>'phone'), ''), 'Chưa có SĐT'),
    nullif(trim(data->>'email'), ''),
    nullif(trim(data->>'company'), ''),
    CASE WHEN data->>'customer_type' IN ('personal', 'business', 'unknown') THEN data->>'customer_type'
         WHEN data->>'customer_type' = 'Cá nhân' THEN 'personal'
         WHEN data->>'customer_type' = 'Doanh nghiệp' THEN 'business'
         ELSE 'unknown' END,
    CASE WHEN coalesce(data->>'quantity', '') ~ '^[0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?$' AND replace(data->>'quantity', ',', '.')::numeric > 0 THEN replace(data->>'quantity', ',', '.')::numeric ELSE NULL END,
    coalesce(nullif(trim(data->>'need'), ''), 'Tư vấn bản quyền phần mềm ' || coalesce(data->>'product', 'CAD')),
    'facebook',
    coalesce(nullif(trim(data->>'lead_status'), ''), 'new'),
    coalesce((data->>'last_contact_at')::timestamptz, now()),
    (data->>'conversation_id') || ':' || coalesce(data->>'product_id', '1369') || ':customer_profile',
    now()
  FROM input
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET
    full_name = coalesce(nullif(trim(excluded.full_name), ''), nullif(leads.full_name, 'Khách Facebook'), excluded.full_name, 'Khách Facebook'),
    phone = CASE 
      WHEN excluded.phone ~ '^[0-9+]+$' AND excluded.phone <> 'Chưa có SĐT' THEN excluded.phone 
      ELSE coalesce(nullif(leads.phone, 'Chưa có SĐT'), excluded.phone, 'Chưa có SĐT') 
    END,
    email = coalesce(excluded.email, leads.email),
    company = coalesce(excluded.company, leads.company),
    customer_type = coalesce(excluded.customer_type, leads.customer_type),
    requested_quantity = coalesce(excluded.requested_quantity, leads.requested_quantity),
    need = coalesce(excluded.need, leads.need),
    status = coalesce(excluded.status, leads.status),
    last_contacted_at = coalesce(excluded.last_contacted_at, leads.last_contacted_at),
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id, conversation_id, product_id, full_name, phone, email, company, customer_type, requested_quantity, need, status, last_contacted_at
),
quote_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO quote_requests (request_code, conversation_id, customer_name, phone, email, company, notes, idempotency_key)
  SELECT
    'QR-' || upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 12)),
    (data->>'conversation_id')::uuid,
    coalesce(nullif(trim(data->>'customer_name'), ''), nullif(trim(data->>'fb_customer_name'), ''), 'Khách Facebook'),
    data->>'phone',
    nullif(trim(data->>'email'), ''),
    nullif(trim(data->>'company'), ''),
    coalesce(nullif(trim(data->>'need'), ''), 'Yêu cầu báo giá ' || coalesce(data->>'product', 'CAD')),
    (data->>'conversation_id') || ':' || coalesce(data->>'product_id', '1369') || ':auto_quote:' || regexp_replace(coalesce(data->>'phone', ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
  FROM input
  WHERE coalesce((data->>'request_quote')::boolean, false)
    AND nullif(trim(data->>'phone'), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND data->>'phone' <> 'Chưa có SĐT'
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET
    customer_name = excluded.customer_name,
    phone = excluded.phone,
    email = excluded.email,
    company = excluded.company,
    notes = excluded.notes,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id, conversation_id, request_code, status
),
quote_item AS (
  INSERT INTO quote_request_items (quote_request_id, product_id, quantity)
  SELECT q.id, coalesce((i.data->>'product_id')::bigint, 1369), greatest(coalesce((i.data->>'quantity')::numeric, 1), 1)
  FROM quote_upsert q CROSS JOIN input i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM quote_request_items existing
    WHERE existing.quote_request_id = q.id AND existing.product_id = coalesce((i.data->>'product_id')::bigint, 1369) AND existing.product_version_id IS NULL
  )
  RETURNING quote_request_id, product_id, quantity
)
SELECT
  l.*,
  coalesce(q.request_code, '') AS quote_code,
  coalesce(q.status, 'CHƯA BÁO GIÁ') AS quotation_status
FROM lead_upsert l
LEFT JOIN quote_upsert q ON q.conversation_id = l.conversation_id;
